umwayi-os

An AI operating system for one person

Drag to look around. Select a station.

sample

The eleven stations

The same stations as the picture, as text.

  • Built

    Memory

    Plain files hold what your AI helpers need to know.

    Private paths are left out of every context bundle.

    umwayi memory bundle

  • Built

    Rules

    Every action gets Yes, No or Ask me first from your rules.

    If anything is unclear, the answer is Ask me first.

    When a state is unknown, the gate is drawn as Ask me first.

    umwayi check

  • Built

    Queue

    Tasks and decisions wait here for you.

    Ask me first puts a decision in the queue.

    umwayi queue list

  • Built

    Archive

    Text you move out leaves a pointer and a fingerprint.

    The fingerprint shows if the text changes later.

    umwayi archive verify

  • Built

    Logbook

    Every change is one entry, and entries are only added.

    Each entry is linked to the one before it, so an edit shows.

    umwayi logbook verify

  • Built

    Automation

    Jobs run on a schedule you set, through systemd timers.

    Each run still passes the kill switch, the rules and the logbook.

    umwayi schedule check

  • Built

    AI helpers

    AI helpers draft. They never publish.

    You read the draft and you post it.

    umwayi steward

  • Built

    Workflows

    Steps run in a fixed order: collect, brief, draft, approve.

    The approve step waits for you.

    umwayi workflow run

  • Built

    Adapters

    Hooks and the front door put your rules before Claude Code and Kiro.

    Every tool call is checked before it runs.

    umwayi agent check

  • Built

    Kill switch

    One flag stops every AI helper, job and workflow.

    If umwayi cannot tell, it stops.

    umwayi kill status

  • Built

    Budget

    A budget per run and per day, in units of one US cent.

    A run that would pass its limit does not start.

    B.10, the capture of one real export, is not done.

    umwayi budget status
